conclusion: Audit adjustment AJE-X01 credits 710 Office Equipment AUD 750.00 and so reverses journal #499 (XJ-499) in full. It also reverses the other lines of #499, the AUD 825.00 in 711 Less Accumulated Depreciation on Office Equipment and the AUD 75.00 in 820 GST; these effects follow from removing the entry. The residual amount is nil, so no misstatement remains.

reasoning_chain.text: AJE-X01 (source XJ-499) credits 710 Office Equipment AUD 750.00 (AJE-X01-2), the full amount by which the asset was overstated.
AJE-X01 also debits 711 Less Accumulated Depreciation on Office Equipment AUD 825.00 (AJE-X01-1) and credits 820 GST AUD 75.00 (AJE-X01-3), the reverse of the other two lines of journal #499.
After management has corrected misstatements at the auditor's request, the auditor performs additional procedures to determine whether misstatements remain (ASA 450 para 7).
The adjustment removes the overstatement of 710 in full, and its effects on 711 and 820 only reverse the rest of journal #499, so no misstatement remains.

counter_argument: A later entry that reinstates the office equipment, or a line of journal #499 that AJE-X01 does not reverse, would show that a misstatement remains.
